summary: This bill requires the Environmental Protection Agency to produce reports and conduct studies on recycling and composting infrastructure, capabilities, and rates across the United States, and to provide technical assistance to improve these programs.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to improve recycling and composting programs, which are direct methods for reducing waste and promoting resource recovery. By gathering data, evaluating infrastructure, and promoting circular markets, the bill directly supports more environmentally friendly waste management practices, thus contributing to environmental protection.
